name: How much does drywall repair cost in the Pasadena area?

mainEntity.name: How much does drywall repair cost in the Pasadena area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of drywall repair in the Pasadena area varies based on the size and type of damage, the materials needed, and the complexity of the repair. Minor repairs, like small holes or cracks, might range from $100 to $300. Larger repairs, especially those involving water damage, extensive patching, or texture matching, can range from $300 to $1,000 or more. Factors like accessibility, the need for plumbing or electrical work, and the final paint finish will also influence the total cost. Most contractors provide an estimate after assessing the specific damage.
